['Select molecule_chembl_id, canonical_smiles, standard_type, standard_relation, standard_value, standard_units', 'From activities', 'Join assays on activities.assay_id = assays.assay_id', 'Join molecule_dictionary on activities.molregno = molecule_dictionary.molregno', 'Join compound_structures on molecule_dictionary.molregno = compound_structures.molregno', "Filter assays.chembl_id = 'CHEMBL1613808'", 'Filter activities.standard_value IS NOT NULL', "Filter activities.standard_relation = '='", 'Return', 'Sort by canonical_smiles, chembl_id, standard_type, standard_relation, standard_value, standard_units', 'Limit 1000']
